# Sample STL Files for Testing

This directory contains minimal STL geometry files for unit and integration testing.

## Files

- `inlet.stl` - Simple inlet patch (single triangle)
- `outlet1.stl` - Simple outlet patch (single triangle)
- `wall.stl` - Simple wall patch (single triangle)

These are minimal ASCII STL files used for testing geometry validation and
mesh setup without requiring large medical imaging datasets.
